payload.title: PPU Triton compiler and AIU lowering tests (triton-for-sail)
payload.summary: The vendor's Triton fork for PPU: the compiler that actually lowers a Triton or Gluon kernel onto this part, so its passes and tests are ground truth for what lowers well versus what silently falls off the fast path. `python/test/unit/ppu/aiu/` exercises the AIU lowering op by op (`test_aiu_dot`, `test_aiu_addmm`, `test_aiu_binary`), and `python/test/unit/ppu/perf/06-fused-attention-aiu.py` is a fused attention written against the AIU path. `python/examples/gluon/01-attention-forward.py` shows the Gluon-level formulation. Source: `reference-projects/triton-for-sail`.

sections.heading: AIU lowering coverage
sections.gist: `python/test/unit/ppu/aiu/` is the per-op contract for what the AIU path supports. An op absent here is unlikely to lower onto the AIU.

sections.heading: Fused attention on the AIU path
sections.gist: `python/test/unit/ppu/perf/06-fused-attention-aiu.py` versus `06-fused-attention.py` isolates exactly which changes the AIU path requires.

sections.heading: Backend passes
sections.gist: `third_party/` and `lib/` hold the PPU backend passes; consult them when a Triton candidate compiles but underperforms for no visible reason.
